paper_title: Upper Limit on the QCD Axion Mass from Isolated Neutron Star Cooling
notes: Paper's main result is an upper limit on the QCD axion mass (m_a < 16 meV at 95% CL for KSVZ). It also reports single-coupling limits: |g_ann| < 1.3e-9 and |g_app| < 1.5e-9 at 95% CL for axion-only-neutron or axion-only-proton models. These are single-point bounds, not mass-dependent exclusion curves, so no (mass, coupling) data points can be extracted as a curve. Figure 3 shows DFSZ m_a vs tan-beta which is not a standard coupling-vs-mass plot. The pre-analysis hint of AxionNeutron is consistent with the g_ann bound but the paper equally constrains g_app; primary result is actually on axion mass.
